name: Redneck Evil
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve cap, long messy hair, torn vest/overalls, tattoos, heavy boots and chained axe. The reference has distressed dark-red marks; do not add injury or gore. Review continuous chain topology, bounded orange flame, clear first-to-second target relay and stable character silhouette.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 8-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns. Use character-specific effects and props; do not add a recurring golden-fist emblem or generic fist-shaped power effect.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Redneck Evil — Chain Reaction.
IDENTITY: exact rugged adult man from reference with long tangled brown hair, scruffy beard, stained red/cream trucker cap, ragged dark sleeveless vest, patched torn gray overalls, tattoos, leather wrist bands, work boots and heavy chained axe. Keep the distressed costume and prop shapes; introduce no new wounds or gore. Existing printed costume marks remain fixed details, never new captions.
0–1.2s: whole-body low-angle shot. He jerks the chained axe off his shoulder and starts one fast overhead orbit, loose chain drawing a huge elliptical arc. At the metal head, one tiny orange ember catches. The grin is cocky and dangerous, an exaggerated cartoon stunt.
1.2–3.2s: camera pulls far back along the axe's flight. He launches it toward a gigantic suspended iron bell twenty feet away. The chain unreels as ONE visible connected line from his hand to the axe. The axe hooks over the bell's top handle rather than chopping anything. He plants both boots in his airborne graphic pose and yanks, swinging the enormous bell across frame like a pendulum. Pure cyan surrounds every object, no support structure, floor or scenery.
3.2–4.8s: the first bell slams broadside into a second smaller iron bell, physically ringing both. An orange fire pulse races visibly down the chain, engulfs only the first bell in a tight ink-edged flame wreath, then jumps across their contact into the second bell a fraction of a second later. Two distinct escalating booms make the CHAIN REACTION readable; the second bell launches backward with a giant bounded orange/ivory impact star and long disconnected tapered trails. No people hit, no body damage, no full-screen fire or smoke.
4.8–6s: snap back as he recalls the chained axe in a clean corkscrew and catches the handle. Exact title CHAIN REACTION drops heavily beside his upper body and settles without obscuring his face. The chain is metal, never a fist-shaped effect.
6–8s: clear whole-character ending with axe resting over his shoulder, one small finite flame licking its head. He pinches that last flame out between two gloved fingertips, then flicks one harmless ember away. His grim grin stays fixed. SFX: heavy chain rattle, building metal whistle, two enormous staggered bell impacts, fast traveling fire rush, chain recall, title slam and tiny flame snuff. No speech, music or narration.
